entities.summary: Brandon Lee Figueroa is an American professional boxer, of Mexican descent. He is a two-weight world champion and has held the World Boxing Association (WBA) featherweight title since February 2026. He previously held the WBA super bantamweight title from 2019 to 2021, the World Boxing Council (WBC) super bantamweight title in 2021, and the WBC featherweight title from 2024 to 2025.
